2.260.19
MapLegend.TextWrapThreshold
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapLegend.TextWrapThreshold element specifies the number of characters after which to
wrap the legend text in a MapLegend. This element is optional.
If this element is present, its value MUST be an Integer ([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.3.17) or an
expression that evaluates to an Integer. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as 25.
The value of this element MUST NOT be a negative number.
Following is the parent element of the MapLegend.TextWrapThreshold element.
Parent elements
MapLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapLegend.TextWrapThreshold element.
 <xsd:element name="TextWrapThreshold" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
